title: intention-extractor
owner: CC (code+proofs); Akien (design: the cocoon, the stage ordering, the settled-bar; disposition of candidates into the intention layer)
intention: The first cocoon stage as a device: raw design prose in, a CANDIDATE intention ({what, why, anchors, read}) out — drafted through inference_domain's resolve seam (sole path, metered, cached), judged by deterministic CHECKS before anyone believes it. Fabricated attribution refuses; the why cannot be skipped; unsupported inference is labeled under `read`, never mixed into what/why.
why: Akien 2026-07-24, verbatim: 'the librarian will have you build something, and you and i can move, say, intention extraction to an agent... until initial intention extraction is a settled issue.' CC is the most expensive resolver — moving extraction upstream spends it parsimoniously (Law 1 on the pipeline). His ordering 2026-07-27: 'i was going to try and do the intention extractor as a device first, but i see that now we start with CC and work outwards' — so it was built LAST of the ring, arriving to find its judge already seated: checks grade the draft, the build gate graded the component's own birth, and downstream the ground truth is whether the build an extraction fed proves out — never CC's opinion.
traces_to: Law 1 — extraction compiled into a watchable stage; the checks compile caught failures so the class stops recurring
Law 3 — an anchor is a measurement against the source; 'settled' stays unmeasured (and says so) until the proof-outcome meter exists
Law 7 — a refusal carries every finding first-pass; REFUSED and UNPARSEABLE breadcrumb the same as PASS
Law 8 — a hollow draft (invented quotes, empty why, invention from an empty source) cannot pass
memory: cocoon-settle-stages-around-cc (the founding design); learns-its-gates (the check registry)

falsifier.proves_green: proof gate: cairn/devices/intention_extractor/proofs/test_intention_extractor.py (12 teeth) under the tester's MEASURED netns seal — validations/test_intention_extractor.json, green, sealed. Build gate: passed live at the PROVEME exit. Durability: committed + pushed.
falsifier.proves_red: mirrors the charter. Wrong-shape signals: a static check registry three caught-bad-extractions from now (the learning half hollow); extractions never feeding real builds (edge b never closes and the device is a prompt wrapper wearing a charter).
falsifier.horizon: re-read when the librarian lands (closes edge a, the cocoon loop) or when the first extraction feeds a real build ticket (starts edge b's meter — Akien's settled-bar of ~2-3 clean tickets becomes measurable then).

questions.a: THE FIRST LIVE FIRE TAUGHT THE CHECK, CROSSING ONE: qwen2.5:7b quoted the founding source verbatim but wrapped every anchor in literal quotation marks — all three honest quotes refused as fabricated. A check that fires on every honest draft gets trained away by its own noise (the leak-scan lesson), so one symmetric outer quote pair is normalized as WRAPPING (_unwrap_quotes) while a fabrication wearing quotes still refuses — both directions pinned by a tooth. Same pattern as inference_domain's first live row catching the ':latest' digest lookup: the proof attests the shape, only the live run shows the content.

THE CACHE INTERPLAY IS THE POINT: the same source builds the same prompt, canonicalizes to the same key — the re-fire was a HIT (host untouched), verdict PASS, avoided-tokens 402->955 on the meter. The parsimonious-prompt aim, measured.
JUDGED, NOT REPAIRED: a candidate is returned unchanged with its findings — a stage that silently fixes drafts trains its own blind spot; disposition is the caller's (CC today, the librarian later).

QUALITY IS NOT IN THE CHECKS' JURISDICTION, SAID LOUD: the live PASS's what/why are a mediocre paraphrase (the draft calls CC 'the user'); the checks catch fabrication and shape, not meaning-drift (words-kept-meanings-replaced) — that catch is CC's and Akien's by read (edge c), and in the cocoon design it is exactly what CC's free-riding inspection pass exists to post-process and feed back.
BORN INSTRUMENTED AND BORN GATED: first device built after the silent-devices clearance (breadcrumbs at birth, not retrofitted) and first whose PROVEME exit faced the live build gate.
